sources.snippet: What Is Jeff? Jeff is an open-source AI classification model project built around fine-tuned Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4 models for developers who need local, low-latency decisions. It accepts a situation and plain-language options, then returns probabilities, a selected option, and confidence without generating text or requiring output parsing.
